title: Piece of crap, don't waste your money.
text:
Piece of crap, don't waste your money.. This got my hopes up. I previously ordered one that hangs over the shower head but apparently if you don't have a shower head from 1970s it won't fit, and hits your back while showering if you try and just deal with it. Anyways......This one was going to be on the opposite side of the shower and because of the plastic, not rust and stand up to my bleach bottle. Would be great in theory but putting the poles together in my shower was a big fat ...Negative!!

After reading the instructions that over complicate the process the poles were in proper position. As soon as I put the slightest pressure on the top bar with the spring to fit up to the ceiling, the pole below began to split in half. What kind of metal splits in half like paper?? Oh yeah, the piece of crap kind. Don't waste your time or money. I'm going to see if I can return this. Oh and by the way, the person/company who shipped mine didn't even bother to put it in a shipping box. So everyone knew what I was ordering. Not that I'm embarrassed, but isn't that the point of shipping? A little bit a privacy so that people don't knick your stuff? Not impressed with amazon today.

Update:
You win amazon; with your perfect customer service I will always be a customer! They just approved a refund, shipping back the same day received.
